gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent Glioblastoma (WHO-Grade IV Glioma); Recurrent Glioblastoma; Glioblastoma (GBM); Recurrent Glioblastoma IDH Wildtype

Histologically confirmed glioblastoma (based on the 2021 WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System, 5th edition), and confirmed CA IX/CA XII positive by histology or \[68Ga\]Ga-XT771 PET/CT.

candidate_evidence.quote: \[177Lu\]Lu-XT771 is designed to specifically target and deliver beta radiation directly to tumor cells that overexpress carbonic anhydrase IX and XII (CA IX and CA XII).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed recurrence of glioblastoma following prior treatments.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: These scans will quantify the drug's distribution and the radiation dose absorbed by both the tumor lesions and normal organs (such as the kidneys).

role_evidence.quote: Participants will receive a single-dose locoregional injection of 3-5 mCi of the investigational radiopharmaceutical, \[177Lu\]Lu-XT771.

agents.drug_class_hint: lutetium-177 labelled CA IX/CA XII-targeted radioligand (investigational, first-in-human)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: binds CA IX and CA XII on tumour cells and delivers localized beta radiation from Lutetium-177

role_evidence.quote: A mandatory pre-treatment leakage test using a \[68Ga\]Ga-XT771 tracer (4-6 mCi) with PET/CT imaging to rule out any leakage into the subcutaneous or subarachnoid spaces

agents.drug_class_hint: gallium-68 labelled XT771 PET tracer (leakage test and CA IX/XII imaging)

role_evidence.quote: Additionally, to prevent cerebral edema, participants will receive a prophylactic course of oral dexamethasone (4 mg, 3 times daily), starting 24 hours prior to the \[177Lu\]Lu-XT771 injection and continuing for a total of 4 days.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: Carbonic anhydrase IX / XII (CA IX/CA XII) expression

source_quote.quote: Histologically confirmed glioblastoma (based on the 2021 WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System, 5th edition), and confirmed CA IX/CA XII positive by histology or \[68Ga\]Ga-XT771 PET/CT.

coder_notes: Phase EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). Radiopharmaceutical named per W1: xt771 with isotope in drug_class_hint; diagnostic 68Ga form listed separately. Delivered into the resection cavity via an implanted Ommaya reservoir: coded formulation_flag new_route and device_dependent false (Ommaya treated as a route of administration, not device activation/FUS-type delivery); adjudicator may prefer device_dependent true under R4. tumour_pk_planned yes based on SPECT/CT quantification of drug distribution in tumour lesions (imaging-based biodistribution rather than tissue/CSF sampling). Dexamethasone is not a registered intervention but every patient receives it per protocol. CA IX/XII positivity is an entry requirement and is the target of XT771. Conditions also mention 'Recurrent Glioblastoma IDH Wildtype' and eligibility cites WHO 2021 (cns5).
